- `join_role_socket`: `join`/`leave` from a role socket. Caller action: only `admin.sock` or a daemon of the group.
- `backup_inside_dir`: `backup` to a file inside `-dir` of the daemon. Caller action: a file outside the data directory.
- `import_repeated`: a repeated `import` after a finished one. Caller action: —.
- `recover_box`: `recover` on a box without raft. Caller action: a copy and `import`.
- `floor_not_integer`: `op: floor`: `floor` is not a JSON integer (`2.0e1`, `20.0`). Caller action: an integer.
- `no_leader`: no leader for the effective `-leader-wait` interval. Caller action: wait; workers live by the lease.
- `leader_lost`: the leader is lost after a write is sent. Caller action: a replay with the same `id` (chapter 1.1).
- `connection_limit`: more connections than the limit. Caller action: repeat not before the deadline.
- `floor_socket`: `floor` not by admin. Caller action: —.
- `floor_not_higher_id`: `floor` not higher than the current one (a new id). Caller action: —.
- `floor_row_write`: `put`/`delete` of the floor row by an ordinary write. Caller action: only `op: floor`.
- `copy_input`: `import`/`restore`: the input is not in the form `copy` of N1.3; the base is smaller than the greatest version; a row larger than the ceiling (on a box — `-max-value` of the command, in a group — of the leader); an epoch or the floor is not decimal; unreadable (including an epoch row of R408 or `platform/epoch_floor` — upper is not reliable). Caller action: another base / fix the copy.
- `clock_early`: `recover`/`restore`: a clock earlier than `generation_at`. Caller action: `-force` removes only the clock refusal; the upper bound/isolation/monotonicity are required.
- `recovery_unsafe`: recovery: upper unknown, the old group not cut off, an overflow, the current floor does not read (`floor_unreadable`). Caller action: restore the preconditions; force does not help.
- `recover_isolated`: `recover` without `-isolated` (N3 step 0). Caller action: isolate the former group and the writers, repeat with `-isolated`.
- `recover_upper`: `recover -upper N`: N is out of the flag form or below the computed upper. Caller action: check the bound; `-upper` only raises.
- `recover_peers`: `recover -peers`: an element not `id@<raft host:port>/<api host:port>`, an empty element, a repeated id or no `-id` among them (N1.3 «Daemon flags» `-peers`). Caller action: fix the list.


- `copy_method`: unsupported method at /v1/copy. Caller action: use GET; HEAD remains bodyless.
- `copy_admin_only`: copy requested through an ordinary role socket or forwarding. Caller action: use the authorized local admin socket; no header grants it.
- `copy_snapshot_unavailable`: a consistent copy cannot be obtained before successful headers within the declared wait. Caller action: retry the read when available; no write outcome is ambiguous.

- `start_data_dir_owned`: a second daemon on a live-owned data directory (N1.3 «Data-directory ownership»). Caller action: do not take ownership; retry only after the owner exits.
- `local_data_dir_owned`: offline box import/restore or local recover on a live-owned directory (N1.3). Caller action: stop the owner first and retain the operation's other preconditions.
- `replay_limit`: a write above the declared replay-processing limit ([P/01.3-R035 «Waits of the doors»](#n2-doors): the limit and its unit are declared by the implementation), before admission; `Retry-After` is the time until admission in seconds, computed by the implementation. Caller action: repeat not before that deadline.
- `import_held`: in a group, a write held by an unfinished `import` or `restore` attempt (N1.3 `import`); nothing is written. Caller action: wait; the operator continues the attempt through `admin.sock` of the leader.
- `admin_not_leader`, `admin_not_leader_cli`: at a follower, on its `admin.sock`: a write, `op: floor`, `import`, `restore`, `POST /v1/join` or `/v1/leave` of another member; the CLI `admit`, `import`, `restore`, `leave <another>` (N1.3 `admin_ops`); nothing changes. Caller action: repeat at the leader (`leader_id` of `/v1/status`).
- `import_other_input`: `import`/`restore` with another input before «Done» of an unfinished attempt (N1.3 `import`); nothing changes. Caller action: repeat with the same input, or after `recover` a new full attempt.
- `floor_unreadable`: `op: floor`: the current `platform/epoch_floor` does not read in its family form (N1.3 `floor`); nothing is written, the floor is not reset. Caller action: repair the floor row; `restore`, `import`, `recover` report `recovery_unsafe`.

- `disk_full`: the disk is full and a write is proven to have been refused before any effect, without a partial result (R257); prior business rows, issued versions and applied-id records are preserved (P/01.1-R295). After an effect or with an unknown result, R330 and the existing `ambiguous_*` outcomes apply. Caller action: restore storage capacity, then retry by the existing write-replay rules.

## Implementation decides

Each implementation names in its description:

1. **the raft transport secret** beyond mTLS, if there is one, and its rotation on revocation; the raft wire between members and the frame of `admin.sock`
   (read-fence, admit, import) remain internal to the implementation: a format with a name and a version, no new HTTP routes. The copy transfer itself uses the explicitly declared GET /v1/copy of N2; the members of one
   store cluster are one implementation, a mix of languages — only by clients through `configstore:///`;
2. **the durability of the store** (fsync, raft snapshots: threshold, interval, tail) — a teaching store MAY be non-durable, and this is said in its description; there is no flag or environment variable that turns the barriers off (N1.3 `durability`);
3. **the connection accounting of the daemon** and overrides of the limits by deployment, `-tuning` for slow networks; the normative defaults are N1.3;
4. **how `backup` obtains a consistent state of a running daemon** (N2); the requirement on the copy is a norm of N2, not a choice.
5. **the format mark and the profile `file://`**: the values `format` and `version` of its mark `FORMAT` and which versions of its format the build reads (N1.3 `format`); the on-disk format of the profile `file://`; the command by which a copy of N1.3 `copy` is taken from a store `file://` (the form of the copy is a norm).
6. **mutual exclusion of runs** of `recover`, `restore`, `import` on one installation (a lock, a mark file) — the norm requires one attempt (N3 «Races: admittance and recovery transitions»), the way is a choice. This also declares exclusive live-daemon ownership of `-dir`, refusal of a second daemon and local operations, and release on every process termination by N1.3, and the form and place of the phase mark of `recover` (N3 «recover the store» step 1).
7. **the internal contract of `file://`** (item 5): the format of the profile `file://` is the implementation's own, not a public contract. Its description
   and the library API are written in the implementation's repository by the owner of this chapter before the code: the physical layer and the command layer — conditional
   `put`/`delete` with `guard`, the batch `batch`, CAS by version, `not_before`/`not_after`, outcomes and refusal words as at the store door (P/01.1 N1,
   N4; without retelling the norms), with vectors from its own code. Other processes of the implementation (the installer, the worker) read only
   the contract and the API; a mix of languages on `file://` is not supported — through `configstore:///`.
8. **the finite budgets of this chapter**: the response-write budget, the commit wait, the number of door attempts and the replay-processing limit (R035), the limit of `admin.sock` (R008), the disk and descriptor budgets (R036). Each MUST be finite and positive; this chapter sets no value, flag or default for them. The implementation declares the value; the threshold of production acceptance is approved separately from the implementation, and a claim of the candidate alone is not enough.

- `-rights`: the rights file
- `-tls`: the root of the certificate kits (N1.6), mTLS of `-raft` and `-api`

- `-raft-bind`: the address on which the daemon listens for raft, if it differs from the named one
- `-api`: the address of the service doors of N2 for partners; the value of `members` and `leader` in `/v1/status`; without `-api` the member is not in `members` (the map can be `{}`; R381)

| Phase | What is allowed | What is kept on a refusal |
|---|---|---|
| Isolation | Stop/cut off the old members, fix the immutable input and upper | The old data; the new group is not started yet |
| Check | Check all rows (form, key, size), the base, the epochs and upper, the uint64 bounds; families of rows — only `recover` of its own dump: for all rows — the row envelope, the key by the catalogue, the version, the size; schemas — only of the families of the store itself (P/01) and upper; the content of other families is not interpreted and is kept as is — schemas are the business of their owners; the copy `copy` knows no manifests (N1.3 `import`) | Neither the floor nor the rows are changed |
| New floor | Raise floor above upper durably, once; op: floor has its own replay id | On an unknown answer repeat with the same id, do not compute a new generation |
| Transfer | Keep the first new floor F1; write all other copy rows with their copy versions, excluding the old platform/epoch_floor; durable progress for continuation | A partial transfer is possible; ordinary writers are forbidden |
| Done | Check every non-floor input row and the saved new F1 row; allow the updated membership/writers | The former group stays cut off; only epochs not below floor are started — one issued with the old floor is lost (P/03.2 N3 «take_epoch(id)») |

When `POST /v1/join` or `POST /v1/leave` has passed [forms/service-checks.tsv](../forms/service-checks.tsv) and the body form (R223, R386, R387, R212), the daemon MUST check the membership by the state of the group: an inadmissible membership is 409 `{kind: refused, error}` — an even group or one larger than declared (R055, R056), the repeats of `repeat` (R179, R310), the leaving of the last voter of a box (R172). A join of one who left before `admit` is the refusal of R058, not this 409.

- `start_config`: daemon: a true `bad` of the flag form (R007); `-bootstrap` with `-join`; `-group-size` outside its form; a declared or listening address (`-api`, `-raft`, `-api-bind`, `-raft-bind`) off the loopback without `-tls`; `-join` without `-tls`; a door certificate at a voter; at TLS startup the own leaf server identity differs from `-id`, for a voter or a door (P/01.3-R047); in a build with raft without `-raft` and without `-door` — `-bootstrap`, `-join`, `-group-size 3` or `5`; `-door` with `-raft`, `-raft-bind`, `-bootstrap`, `-join` or `-group-size`; `-raft` on a fresh directory without `-bootstrap` and without `-join` (N1.3 `box`). Caller action: fix `configstore.env`.

- `start_flags`: daemon: a flag outside the table «Daemon flags» or of another command, a repeated flag, a `bool` with a value, a positional word, a value out of its type, an unmet `required` (R007, except the `start_config` causes above): no `-dir`; no `-id` in a group; no `-id` and no `SERVER_NAME`; `-door` without `-voters`; an inherited socket with a name that is neither `admin` nor a role of the rights file (N1.3). Caller action: fix the unit or `configstore.env`.

- `start_format`: the data directory is not empty but there is no mark `FORMAT`; foreign `format` or `version`; `FORMAT` out of form; a directory of another start mode, also for an offline `import`, `restore` or `recover` (N1.3 `format`, R403, R404). Caller action: take a copy with the former implementation or mode (`backup`) and restore it into a fresh directory.

- `copy_input`: `import`/`restore`: the input is not in the form `copy` of N1.3, including CRLF or EOF before an object's LF (P/01.3-R093, P/01.3-R361); the base is smaller than the greatest version; a row larger than the ceiling (on a box — `-max-value` of the command, in a group — of the leader); an epoch or the floor is not decimal; unreadable (including an epoch row of R408 or `platform/epoch_floor` — upper is not reliable). Caller action: another base / fix the copy.

- `recover_peers`: `recover -peers`: an element not `id@<raft host:port>/<api host:port>`, an empty element, a repeated id or no `-id` among them (N1.3 «Daemon flags» `-peers`). Caller action: fix the list.

- `admin_not_leader`, `admin_not_leader_cli`: at a follower, on its `admin.sock`: a write, `op: floor`, `import`, `restore`, `POST /v1/join` or `/v1/leave` of another member; the CLI `admit`, `import`, `restore`, `leave <another>` (N1.3 `admin_ops`); nothing changes. Caller action: repeat at the leader (`leader_id` of `/v1/status`).

- `floor_unreadable`: `op: floor`: the current `platform/epoch_floor` does not read in its family form (N1.3 `floor`); nothing is written, the floor is not reset. Caller action: repair the floor row; `restore`, `import`, `recover` report `recovery_unsafe`.

- `import_held`: in a group, a write held by an unfinished `import` or `restore` attempt (N1.3 `import`); nothing is written. Caller action: wait; the operator continues the attempt through `admin.sock` of the leader.

- `admin_ops` — If at a follower (a voter that is not the leader), on its `admin.sock`, comes a write (Cmd, batch, `op: floor`), `import`, `restore`, `admit`, or `POST /v1/join` or `/v1/leave` of another member, then it MUST be `admin_not_leader`: 503 `unavailable` without `Retry-After`; nothing changes; the operator repeats at the leader (`leader_id` of `/v1/status`); the daemon does not forward them.

- `admin_ops` — A follower MUST check `admin_not_leader` (R118) after the frame, the route, the method, the identity and the form of the body (400), and before the table [forms/write-checks.tsv](../forms/write-checks.tsv), before the membership checks (409) and before it reads the input of a copy of `import` or `restore`.
- `admin_ops` — For `POST /v1/join` and `/v1/leave` at a follower the daemon MUST read the body before `admin_not_leader`: the `id` of the body tells oneself (R119) from another member.

- `import` (fresh) — `import` and `restore` MUST go from an immutable copy (`copy`) into a fresh group — not a single row, except the rows of doors without a vote `platform/configstore-doors/<id>` (service rows of the group itself, `door`): a live door writes its own every `DOOR_SEEN_EVERY` — it does not cancel the freshness. Continuation of the same unfinished attempt follows P/01.3-R151/P/01.3-R152. For a box the fresh-directory rule is P/01.3-R175.

- `import` (base) — The versions of the copy were not handed out by the group and can coincide with a version handed out in the fresh group before the transfer (there are only door rows there): for a door row the version can return lower — no harm, the door writes its row without `cas` and within 30 s rewrites it above the base.

- `import` (check) — Before changing the floor or any row, `import` and `restore` MUST make a full preliminary check: the copy form (a `Row` line — R361, the key — R371, the size — R372), the versions (the base — R142, R143, `index` of the header — R363) and the epochs (R147, R374, R375); a bad row, size, base, epoch — a refusal without changes.

- `import` (floor_first) — The first write of the transfer MUST be the new floor F1, with its new `index` greater than the transfer base and every version already handed out by the destination, and `generation_at` at that raise. This applies to import and restore in a group or on a box; continuation keeps that exact F1 index (P/01.3-R151). All other input rows keep their copy versions (P/01.3-R140).

- `import` (replay) — After the floor is published a refusal can leave part of the rows; a replay with the same input (the implementation compares the bytes of the copy, the way is its choice) MUST continue the same attempt with the same floor.
- `import` (held_writers.box) — Ordinary writers are not admitted until completion: on a box the daemon MUST NOT start on such a directory (code 2, the log — repeat `import` with the same input).
- `import` (held_writers.group) — In a group the daemon MUST hold writers until the attempt is continued through `admin.sock` of the leader: a held write gets 503 `unavailable` (`import_held`).

- `box` — `import`/`restore` on a box MUST go into a fresh directory of a stopped daemon, not through `admin.sock` (in a group — `admin.sock` of the leader, `admin_ops`); `restore` coincides with `import` (there are no neighbours).
- `recover_peers`: the -peers form or own-id requirement of R007. Caller action: fix the list.

- [ ] **P/01.3-01** [test, reading, stand] the daemon: the flags of N1.3, the store of a box without raft (`box`) — sc. 04 and by reading, `members` without `-api` — `{}` (sc. 16), start refusals, sizes 1/3/5, joining and `-force`, `leave`/`admit`, the effective `-leader-wait` interval — sc. 07, 17 (the group stand); mTLS, sockets — by reading; the 503 branch «no leader for the effective `-leader-wait` interval» — sc. 17; unavailable with Retry-After at the connection limit — the [probe](../probes/README.md) `01-connections`; ambiguous after a forwarded write lost its answer — at a door with and without `id` and at a follower, a replay with the same `id` gives `again` — sc. 32–34 (the group stand); that a door does not retry a write without `id` — by reading; the production loss of the leader stays a debt of the [probe debt table](production-acceptance.md#probe-debt) (judge-only: sc. 04, 07, 16, 17, 32, 33, 34; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R007, P/01.3-R016, P/01.3-R064, P/01.3-R320, P/01.3-R326, P/01.3-R328)

- [ ] **P/01.3-14** [reading] an interrupted `import` in a group and an interrupted `recover`, a request not admitted at stop, the temporary `backup` file, the waits and limits of R035, the disk and descriptors of R036, the limit of `admin.sock` — by reading until their probes appear; each is a row of the [probe debt table](production-acceptance.md#probe-debt).

**Membership outcomes.** After the request refusals of R016, an unfinished transfer gives R413. Otherwise a box joins its own id with 200 `{}` (R171), refuses a foreign id with 409 even with force (R308), refuses leave with 409 (R172) and admit with non-zero exit (R173). A door refuses join/leave with 409 (R087) and admit by R417. At a follower, own join/leave can reach the leader by R119; another member's join/leave on admin.sock and any admit refuse by R118/R235. A group peer may leave only itself; another id requires the leader's admin.sock (R214). At the leader, an id barred by leave gets 403 on join until admit (R058); a current id with the same Raft address joins with 200 and updates API (R178), another Raft address gets 409 (R179). A new member is accepted with 200 only within the declared size and with force for transitional evenness (R055/R056/R352). Leave of a known member gives 200 unless it is the last voter (R416); unknown id gives 409 (R310). Admit confirms permission to rejoin with exit 0, including a repeat for an already admitted correct id; it changes no rows and does not itself join the id (R177/R234). On an unknown join/leave/admit result the caller reads membership (R228/R234).

From Check until Done of import/restore/recover, a running daemon MUST keep the ordinary outcomes of status, rights and metrics; these diagnostic commands do not expose partially transferred rows. Availability and access failures of their own doors remain applicable.

A concurrent import, restore or recover on the same installation MUST refuse with non-zero exit without changing data. After interruption, the same input continues by R152, another input refuses by R153, and recover restarts by R339; concurrency is not continuation.

Leave of the last voter of a Raft group MUST return 409 `refused` without membership or row changes, including a one-voter group; force does not permit it. This is the same visible refusal as the box's R172.
Admit on a door without a vote MUST refuse with non-zero exit without changing membership or rows; it cannot grant admission through another instance.

During offline box import/restore or local recover, the daemon is stopped: status, rights, join, leave, admit, backup and all HTTP doors have no serving socket on that instance; no HTTP reply is promised. A start on an unfinished box transfer or a recover phase mark MUST refuse with exit 2 (R048/R267); startup after Done follows R292, subject to R341. A local command on a live-owned directory instead gives R185.

- `service_body_form`: service HTTP: unknown fields, not an object/not JSON, extra JSON, a detected framing violation or an inadmissible field. EOF/truncation follows R054 without an HTTP refusal; input-phase timeout is `input_timeout`. Caller action: fix the input; there is no side change.
- `service_body_limit`: service HTTP: a body larger than `-max-body`, whatever the method (R221). Caller action: shrink the body; the limit is by actual bytes.
- `floor_not_integer`: `op: floor`: `floor` is not a JSON integer (`2.0e1`, `20.0`). Caller action: an integer.

- `import_other_input`: `import`/`restore` with another input before «Done» of an unfinished attempt (N1.3 `import`); nothing changes. Caller action: repeat with the same input, or after `recover` a new full attempt.

- `copy_snapshot_unavailable`: a consistent copy cannot be obtained before successful headers within the declared wait, or the instance is a door (P/01.3-R411). Caller action: retry the read when available; no write outcome is ambiguous.
- `start_data_dir_owned`: a second daemon on a live-owned data directory (N1.3 «Data-directory ownership»). Caller action: do not take ownership; retry only after the owner exits.
- `local_data_dir_owned`: offline box import/restore or local recover on a live-owned directory (N1.3). Caller action: stop the owner first and retain the operation's other preconditions.

- `replay_limit`: a write above the declared replay-processing limit ([P/01.3-R035 «Waits of the doors»](#n2-doors): the limit and its unit are declared by the implementation), before admission; `Retry-After` is the time until admission in seconds, computed by the implementation. Caller action: repeat not before that deadline.

**Flag purposes.** [forms/daemon-flags.tsv](../forms/daemon-flags.tsv) alone owns the closed set, types, defaults, requiredness, commands and refusal predicates. `-dir` names the data directory (R181); `-id` is the member name in `members`, `voters`, `leader_id`. The socket commands of `admin_ops` find `admin.sock` by `-sockets`; local `recover` does not. `-rights` names the rights file; `-tls` the certificate-kit root (N1.6). `-raft` names the advertised Raft address, `-raft-bind` its listener; `-api` and `-api-bind` follow R409. `-bootstrap` starts the first member, `-join` names a member's API address, `-group-size` declares the size (R053–R061). `-door` and `-voters` follow R074; `-tuning` R052; `-leader-wait` R063. `-max-value` is the row ceiling (R146, R373), `-max-body` the entity-body limit (R319); `-max-conns`, `-api-conns`, `-api-per-address` are the connection limits (R008). `-force` follows R352/R368; `-isolated` R262; `-upper` R263. `-peers` names the recovered membership: remaining ids with Raft/API addresses, including `-id`. `--from` is the immutable copy input; `-index-base` follows R143/R300. `-groups` belongs to `rights`.
